name: Bismuth
title: bismuth.sh
shortDescription: Bismuth is an AI-powered tool designed for developers working with Go, Python, and JS/TS codebases. It scans your codebase, identifies bugs, and automatically generates pull requests that are regression-tested. This helps teams ship more features while ensuring security and reducing bugs. Ideal for teams looking to enhance their development workflow and maintain high code quality.
pros: Automates pull request generation and testing
Customizable with SDK for specific workflows
cons: May not catch all types of bugs
